title: Lost in Athens, part four
lines: My phone will not take a charge. The corporate card got declined at the Motel 28 outside Ypsilanti. And Bowling Green just denied my press pass.
Interstate 75 is a lonely place when your check engine light is on, and the only thing balder than me is my rear tires.
But hey. Bright side. Craig is going to call me back. T Kennedy is going to call me back. Any minute now.
I know Quinnipiac is around here somewhere. That school is like a church camp. Who do I know that runs the church camps?
Great Caesar's ghost. I'm gonna call Derrick.
Derrick! It's Pastor Rodney Bumrod. Pick up, son. I got a proposition.
